exposure: Extremely low birth weight (ELBW) defined as <1000 grams
finding: The study found a significant mean difference in survival time based on gestational age between infants delivered vaginally and those delivered by cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as an independent predictor of survival for ELBW infants.
gest_age: Infants born with ELBWs of less than 1000 grams
